title: Variable read but never set
description:
Error-prone rule — a variable is read although nothing in the catalog ever writes it. Either the writing side was renamed or removed, or the value is expected to arrive from outside the exported files. Let() definitions are excluded: they are defined and read inside the same formula and would otherwise dominate the result.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "ListVarsUndefined" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A read without a write evaluates to empty. Where the calculation expected a value, the result is an empty comparison, an empty parameter or an empty find request — and none of that raises an error at runtime.
rule.remediation: Check where the value was supposed to come from: a renamed write, a script parameter that is never unpacked, or a variable set in a file outside this export. Restore the write or drop the read.

meta.name: Variable read but never set
meta.author: fm-lab rules
meta.description: Error-prone rule — a variable is read although nothing in the catalog ever writes it.
meta.calibration: Let() variables are excluded outright — measured on a large solution they outnumber the real findings roughly five to one. Severity is deliberately informational: script parameters and cross-file writes are legitimate sources the export cannot see.
